BrochureContent.Content:
Fronting onto a large green with the added benefit of a sleepy cul de sac location number 176 is a simply stunning four bedroom semi detached property that comes to market in pristine condition boasting a wealth of excellent features. The light filled interior showcases a most appealing décor with flair and design evident throughout giving the property a stylish contemporary twist. Number 176 is an ideal family home boasting well laid out accommodation with well proportioned rooms throughout. The accommodation on offer briefly comprises of entrance hall, spacious front reception, large open plan kitchen/dining area, good size utility, guest WC, four fine sized bedrooms, master ensuite and main bathroom. This beautiful abode is sure to delight prospective buyers appealing to a wide audience and set to attract a lot of interest.

Outside the property benefits from good off street parking to the front with side access leading to a private sunny rear garden that enjoys excellent privacy with a wonderful leafy aspect to the rear. A large patio area leads on to a pleasant mix of lawn and stone chippings making for an ideal play area.

Centrally located, Cois Na hAbhainn is only minutes walk from Tuam Town centre. Tuam offers a wealth of amenities, boasting a wide selection of shops, cafes, restaurants, bars, leisure facilities, a wonderful public park and excellent schools. The M17 motorway has now made Tuam a commuter Town bringing with it strong interest from Galway buyers. Regular daily bus services from Burkes Bus, GoBus and Bus Eireann to Galway and beyond makes commuting hassle free.

Contact our office today to avoid disappointment!!
